message.content:
Here’s a classic lasagna recipe with all the essential ingredients. Feel free to tweak quantities or add extras to suit your taste!

| Category | Ingredient | Typical Amount (for 8‑person casserole) |
|----------|------------|----------------------------------------|
| **Lasagna Noodles** | Regular or no‑boil lasagna sheets | 12–15 sheets |
| **Meat Sauce** | Ground beef (or a mix of beef & pork) | 1½–2 lb (680–900 g) |
| | Onion, finely chopped | 1 medium |
| | Garlic cloves, minced | 3–4 |
| | Crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce | 28 oz (800 g) |
| | Tomato paste | 2 Tbsp |
| | Red wine (optional) | ½ cup |
| | Olive oil | 2 Tbsp |
| | Salt, pepper | to taste |
| | Italian seasoning or dried basil & oregano | 1 tsp each |
| | Fresh basil or parsley (optional) | ¼ cup chopped |
| | Sugar (to balance acidity) | 1 tsp (optional) |
| **Ricotta Mixture** | Ricotta cheese | 15 oz (425 g) |
| | Egg (helps bind) | 1 large |
| | Grated Parmesan | ½ cup |
| | Fresh parsley or basil, chopped | ¼ cup |
| | Salt, pepper | to taste |
| **Bechamel (White Sauce)** | Butter | 4 Tbsp |
| | All‑purpose flour | 4 Tbsp |
| | Milk (whole or 2%) | 4 cups |
| | Nutmeg (fresh grated) | pinch |
| | Salt, pepper | to taste |
| **Cheese Layer** | Shredded mozzarella | 3 cups |
| | Grated Parmesan | 1 cup |
| | Optional: shredded provolone or fontina | ½ cup |
| **Optional Extras** | Sautéed spinach or kale | 2 cups |
| | Roasted red peppers | 1 cup |
| | Mushrooms, sliced | 1 cup |
| | Black olives, sliced | ½ cup |
| | Pine nuts or walnuts (for crunch) | ¼ cup |

### Quick Prep Steps
1. **Cook the noodles** (if not using no‑boil) until al dente, then drain and set aside.
2. **Make the meat sauce**: sauté onion & garlic in olive oil, add ground meat until browned, stir in tomatoes, wine, seasonings, and simmer for 20–30 min.
3. **Prepare the ricotta mixture**: combine ricotta, egg, Parmesan, herbs, salt, and pepper.
4. **Whisk the bechamel**: melt butter, whisk in flour, gradually add milk, cook until thickened, season with nutmeg, salt, and pepper.
5. **Assemble**: In a baking dish, spread a thin layer of meat sauce, lay noodles, dollop ricotta mixture, drizzle bechamel, sprinkle mozzarella, repeat layers, finishing with a generous cheese topping.
6. **Bake**: 375 °F (190 °C) for 45–55 min, or until bubbly and golden. Let rest 10 min before serving.

Enjoy your homemade lasagna!
